records.jp: あれは……
records.en: Those are...

records.jp: お祭りを楽しんでる子供たち、かな
records.en_original: Kids enjoying the festival, it seems.
records.en_auxiliary: Kids enjoying the festival, it seems.
records.en: Kids enjoying the festival, it seems.

records.jp: きららがまだ小さい頃……<CR>小学生の頃とかの思い出が中心みたいだね
records.en_original: Back when Kirara was still little... Looks like your memories are centered around from your elementary school days.
records.en_auxiliary: Back when Kirara was still little... Looks like your memories are centered around from your elementary school days.
records.en: These memories seem to center on when Kirara was still little...<CR>around her elementary-school years.

records.jp: きららの、子供の頃……
records.en: Kirara's childhood...

records.jp: 聞いたぞ、お前たち！
records.en_original: Hey, I heard all about you!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, I heard all about you!
records.en: Hey, I heard all about you!
...Who are you?

records.jp: お、同じクラスのケイタくんだよ
records.en_original: Oh, that's Keita. He's in our class.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, that's Keita. He's in our class.
records.en: O-oh, that's Keita-kun. He's in our class.

records.jp: お前……神の声が聞こえるんだってな！
records.en_original: They said you could hear the Divine!
records.en_auxiliary: They said you could hear the Divine!
records.en: I heard... you can hear the voice of the Divine!
What...?

records.jp: そうだけど
records.en: Yes, that's right.

records.jp: へえ……おもしろそーじゃん
records.en: Huh... Sounds interesting.

records.jp: 神の声…………
records.en: The voice of the Divine...

records.jp: きらら、神の声が聞こえるって……？
records.en: Kirara, you can hear the voice of the Divine...?

records.jp: ……思い出してきた
records.en: Kirara is beginning to remember...

records.jp: きららは昔から、<CR>普通の人には聞こえない声が聞こえる体質だった
records.en_original: Ever since I was young, I was able to hear voices no one else could hear.
records.en_auxiliary: Ever since I was young, I was able to hear voices no one else could hear.
records.en: Ever since Kirara was young,<CR>she could hear voices ordinary people could not.

records.jp: 最初は空耳かと思った。でも、違った
records.en_original: At first, I thought it was just my imagination. I was wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: At first, I thought it was just my imagination. I was wrong.
records.en: At first, Kirara thought it was just her imagination. But she was wrong.

records.jp: 聞こえてきていたのは、<CR>この世界の神の声だった
records.en_original: It was the voice of a god known as the Divine.
records.en_auxiliary: It was the voice of a god known as the Divine.
records.en: The voice Kirara had been hearing<CR>was the voice of the Divine.

records.jp: もしかしてきららって……めちゃすごい子？
records.en_original: Wait, so Kirara is like, super magical or something?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, so Kirara is like, super magical or something?
records.en: Does that mean Kirara is... like, super amazing?

records.jp: その恐れがある
records.en: It is likely, yes.

records.jp: 自分で言うんだ……
records.en: You'd say so yourself.

records.jp: 神の声が聞こえる、かぁ……。<CR>またすごい子が現れたなぁ……
records.en_original: Looks like we've got ourselves another interesting girl.
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like we've got ourselves another interesting girl.
records.en: Hearing the voice of the Divine, huh...<CR>Another incredible girl has appeared...

records.jp: （にしても、管理者に、神の声って……。<CR>こころたちの世界は一体どうなっちゃってるんだ？）
records.en_original: (Overseers of worlds and now someone who can hear god directly? What is going on in this world?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Overseers of worlds and now someone who can hear god directly? What is going on in this world?)
records.en: (First overseers, and now the voice of the Divine...<CR>What in the world is going on with Kokoro and the others' world?)

records.jp: 神の声って、どんなふうに聞こえるの？
records.en_original: So, what's it like hearing this voice?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what's it like hearing this voice?
records.en: So, what's it like hearing this voice?

records.jp: ん～。ぼわわわん、って感じ
records.en: Hmm... It's like... bo-wa-wa-wan.

records.jp: ぼわわわん……？？
records.en: Bo-wa-wa-wan...?

records.jp: 頭の中に、ぼわわわん
records.en: Bo-wa-wa-wan, inside Kirara's head.

records.jp: なるほどなるほど……
records.en: I see, I see...

records.jp: 今ので分かんの！？
records.en: That made sense to you?!

records.jp: じゃあ、内容はどんなものなの？
records.en_original: What does the voice say to you?
records.en_auxiliary: What does the voice say to you?
records.en: What does the voice say to you?

records.jp: 人間の言葉に直すのは難しい。<CR>言葉というより、情報そのものが流れ込んでくるから
records.en_original: Hard to explain. It's not so much words as it is data that flows into my mind.
records.en_auxiliary: Hard to explain. It's not so much words as it is data that flows into my mind.
records.en: It's difficult to put into human language.<CR>Rather than words, the information itself flows into Kirara.

records.jp: 少なくとも、普通の人間には知りえない情報。<CR>そこには、未来の情報が含まれてることもある
records.en_original: It's often things normal humans would have no way of knowing, such as the future and the like.
records.en_auxiliary: It's often things normal humans would have no way of knowing, such as the future and the like.
records.en: At the very least, it's information ordinary humans could never know.<CR>Sometimes it even includes information about the future.

records.jp: み、未来！？　未来予知できるってこと！？
records.en_original: Whoa, you can see the future?!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, you can see the future?!
records.en: Whoa, you can see the future?!

records.jp: いや、そこまで正確じゃない
records.en: No, it's not that precise.

records.jp: 久野さんは、いくつかの情報を組み合わせると<CR>未来予知っぽいことができると前に言ってました
records.en_original: Kirara told us that she can combine bits of the data she gets to get an idea of what may happen.
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara told us that she can combine bits of the data she gets to get an idea of what may happen.
records.en: Kuno-san told us before that by combining several pieces of information,<CR>she can do something resembling prediction of the future.

records.jp: っぽいことだとしてもすごいよ！
records.en: Still, that's pretty amazing!

records.jp: うん……
records.en: Yeah...
